#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read-only input-equivalence proof; no application execution or source edit."""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import time

ROOT = Path("/workspace/scratch/4f6714f1660a/crispcloud")
OUT = ROOT / "docs/evidence/storage-ntfs-20261114/final-portable"
EXECUTED = "dec983b2fcb71dea7f90e1020c5d73e3f926a3f6"
CORRECTED = "c2c17f7a273c45760fd54b9e5a8fe3cd57b0d51b"
TEST = "test/archive_ntfs_reader_test.dart"
NAME = "runtime-equivalence-dec983b2-to-c2c17f7.json"
COMMANDS = []
STARTED = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def digest(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def file_record(path):
    hasher = hashlib.sha256()
    count = 0
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            count += len(block)
            hasher.update(block)
    return {"bytes": count, "sha256": hasher.hexdigest()}


def git(*args):
    started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    before = time.monotonic()
    command = ["git", *args]
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, check=False)
    COMMANDS.append({
        "argv": command, "cwd": str(ROOT), "started_utc": started,
        "finished_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "elapsed_seconds": round(time.monotonic() - before, 3),
        "exit_code": result.returncode,
        "stdout_bytes": len(result.stdout), "stdout_sha256": digest(result.stdout),
        "stderr": result.stderr.decode(), "stderr_sha256": digest(result.stderr),
    })
    result.check_returncode()
    return result.stdout


def tree(revision):
    result = {}
    for item in git("ls-tree", "-r", "-z", revision).split(b"\0"):
        if not item:
            continue
        metadata, name = item.split(b"\t", 1)
        mode, kind, blob = metadata.decode().split()
        result[name.decode()] = {"mode": mode, "kind": kind, "git_blob": blob}
    return result


def inventory_digest(rows):
    return digest(json.dumps(rows, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode())


receipt_path = OUT / "ntfs-final-portable-receipt.json"
receipt_bytes = receipt_path.read_bytes()
qualification = json.loads(receipt_bytes)
assert qualification["source_revision"] == EXECUTED
assert qualification["result"] == "passed"
binding_path = OUT / qualification["compiler_input_binding"]["path"]
binding_bytes = binding_path.read_bytes()
assert digest(binding_bytes) == qualification["compiler_input_binding"]["sha256"]
binding = json.loads(gzip.decompress(binding_bytes))
assert binding["qualification_source_revision"] == EXECUTED
assert binding["inputs"] == 606 and len(binding["files"]) == 606
expected = {
    path: {"bytes": row["bytes"], "sha256": row["sha256"]}
    for path, row in binding["files"].items()
}
assert inventory_digest(expected) == binding["inventory_sha256_before"] == binding["inventory_sha256_after"]
assert str(ROOT / TEST) not in expected

head_before = git("rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip()
git("merge-base", "--is-ancestor", EXECUTED, CORRECTED)
git("merge-base", "--is-ancestor", CORRECTED, head_before)
head_delta_before = git("diff", "--name-only", CORRECTED, head_before).decode().splitlines()
assert all(path.startswith("docs/") for path in head_delta_before)
changed = git("diff", "--name-status", "--no-renames", EXECUTED, CORRECTED).decode()
changes = [{"status": line.split("\t", 1)[0], "path": line.split("\t", 1)[1]}
           for line in changed.splitlines()]
non_docs = [row for row in changes if not row["path"].startswith("docs/")]
assert non_docs == [{"status": "M", "path": TEST}], non_docs
patch = git("diff", "--no-ext-diff", "--unified=8", EXECUTED, CORRECTED, "--", TEST).decode()
old_tree, new_tree = tree(EXECUTED), tree(CORRECTED)
assert set(old_tree).symmetric_difference(new_tree).issubset(
    {path for path in set(old_tree) | set(new_tree) if path.startswith("docs/")}
)
for path in set(old_tree) & set(new_tree):
    if not path.startswith("docs/") and path != TEST:
        assert old_tree[path] == new_tree[path], path

inputs_before = {path: file_record(Path(path)) for path in sorted(expected)}
assert inputs_before == expected
tracked_inputs = []
untracked_repository_inputs = []
external_inputs = []
for path in sorted(expected):
    resolved = Path(path)
    if resolved.is_relative_to(ROOT):
        relative = resolved.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
        if relative not in old_tree or relative not in new_tree:
            untracked_repository_inputs.append(relative)
            continue
        old, new = old_tree[relative], new_tree[relative]
        assert old == new and old["kind"] == "blob", relative
        raw = resolved.read_bytes()
        live_blob = hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(raw)).encode() + b"\0" + raw).hexdigest()
        assert live_blob == old["git_blob"]
        tracked_inputs.append({
            "path": relative, "executed_revision_blob": old["git_blob"],
            "corrected_revision_blob": new["git_blob"], "live_blob": live_blob,
            "mode": old["mode"], **expected[path],
        })
    else:
        external_inputs.append(path)
assert untracked_repository_inputs == [".dart_tool/package_config.json"]

package_path = ROOT / qualification["package_config"]["path"]
package_before = file_record(package_path)
assert package_before == {key: qualification["package_config"][key] for key in ["bytes", "sha256"]}
executables_before = {
    name: file_record(Path(row["path"])) for name, row in qualification["executables"].items()
}
assert executables_before == {
    name: {key: row[key] for key in ["bytes", "sha256"]}
    for name, row in qualification["executables"].items()
}
manifests = {}
for name in ["pubspec.yaml", "pubspec.lock"]:
    assert old_tree[name] == new_tree[name]
    current = file_record(ROOT / name)
    assert current["sha256"] == qualification["production_manifest_hashes"][name]
    manifests[name] = {"git_blob_at_both_revisions": old_tree[name]["git_blob"], **current}

corrected_test = (ROOT / TEST).read_bytes()
corrected_test_blob = hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(corrected_test)).encode() + b"\0" + corrected_test).hexdigest()
assert corrected_test_blob == new_tree[TEST]["git_blob"]
compiled_path = Path(qualification["compiled_output"]["path"])
compiled = file_record(compiled_path)
assert compiled == {key: qualification["compiled_output"][key] for key in ["bytes", "sha256"]}

inputs_after = {path: file_record(Path(path)) for path in sorted(expected)}
package_after = file_record(package_path)
executables_after = {
    name: file_record(Path(row["path"])) for name, row in qualification["executables"].items()
}
assert inputs_before == inputs_after == expected
assert package_before == package_after
assert executables_before == executables_after
assert receipt_path.read_bytes() == receipt_bytes
assert binding_path.read_bytes() == binding_bytes
head_after = git("rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip()
git("merge-base", "--is-ancestor", CORRECTED, head_after)
head_delta_after = git("diff", "--name-only", CORRECTED, head_after).decode().splitlines()
assert all(path.startswith("docs/") for path in head_delta_after)

result = {
    "schema": 1, "result": "equivalent",
    "scope": "Exact portable compiler/runtime input equivalence for a native-test-only correction.",
    "started_utc": STARTED, "finished_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "actual_portable_execution_revision": EXECUTED,
    "corrected_native_test_revision": CORRECTED,
    "applications_executed_for_this_receipt": False,
    "portable_executions_at_corrected_revision_claimed": False,
    "qualification_reuse": "The recorded dec983b2 portable results apply to the unchanged compiler/runtime inputs present at c2c17f7. Execution attribution remains dec983b2; this is a separate equivalence proof.",
    "qualification_receipt": {"path": receipt_path.name, "bytes": len(receipt_bytes), "sha256": digest(receipt_bytes), "unchanged": True},
    "original_compiler_input_binding": {
        "path": binding_path.name, "stored": file_record(binding_path),
        "uncompressed_sha256": digest(gzip.decompress(binding_bytes)),
        "contains_complete_606_input_list_and_hashes": True, "unchanged": True,
    },
    "observed_head_before": head_before, "observed_head_after": head_after,
    "head_changes_beyond_corrected_revision_are_documentation_only": True,
    "head_documentation_delta_before": head_delta_before,
    "head_documentation_delta_after": head_delta_after,
    "revision_changes": changes, "only_non_documentation_changed_path": TEST,
    "all_other_non_documentation_git_tree_entries_equal": True,
    "corrected_test": {
        "path": TEST, "executed_revision_blob": old_tree[TEST]["git_blob"],
        "corrected_revision_blob": new_tree[TEST]["git_blob"],
        "live_blob_matches_corrected_revision": True,
        "absent_from_all_actual_compiler_inputs": True,
        "change": "Move the ordinary '.' filename control out of the unsafe-component loop and expect corrupt for its earlier duplicate root-index-key refusal. No reader or fixture producer behavior changes.",
        "patch_sha256": digest(patch.encode()), "patch": patch,
    },
    "actual_compiler_inputs": {
        "count": 606, "every_input_checked_before_and_after": True,
        "every_input_matches_original_execution": True,
        "original_inventory_sha256": binding["inventory_sha256_before"],
        "current_inventory_sha256_before": inventory_digest(inputs_before),
        "current_inventory_sha256_after": inventory_digest(inputs_after),
        "tracked_repository_input_count": len(tracked_inputs),
        "tracked_repository_inputs": tracked_inputs,
        "all_tracked_compiler_input_git_blobs_equal_at_both_revisions": True,
        "untracked_repository_inputs": untracked_repository_inputs,
        "external_sdk_or_package_input_count": len(external_inputs),
        "full_input_list_reference": binding_path.name,
    },
    "package_config": {"path": str(package_path), "before": package_before, "after": package_after,
                       "matches_actual_execution": True},
    "production_manifests": manifests,
    "executables": {
        name: {"path": qualification["executables"][name]["path"], "before": row,
               "after": executables_after[name], "matches_actual_execution": True}
        for name, row in executables_before.items()
    },
    "retained_compiled_javascript": {"path": str(compiled_path), **compiled, "matches_executed_program": True},
    "git_read_commands": COMMANDS,
    "limits": [
        "No application, compiler, or native test suite was rerun for this receipt.",
        "The corrected native test suite needs its own c2c17f7 execution receipt.",
        "This proof does not reattribute the prior portable or web-build executions to c2c17f7.",
    ],
    "verification_harness": {"scratch_path": str(Path(__file__)), "sha256": digest(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),
                             "source": Path(__file__).read_text()},
}
result_bytes = (json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n").encode()
(OUT / NAME).write_bytes(result_bytes)
index_path = OUT / "INDEX.json"
index = json.loads(index_path.read_text())
assert index["qualification_source_revision"] == EXECUTED
index["native_test_correction_equivalence"] = {
    "path": NAME, "bytes": len(result_bytes), "sha256": digest(result_bytes),
    "actual_portable_execution_revision": EXECUTED,
    "equivalent_compiler_runtime_revision": CORRECTED,
    "all_606_actual_inputs_unchanged": True,
    "portable_execution_at_later_revision_claimed": False,
}
index["files"] = [item for item in index["files"] if item["path"] != NAME]
index["files"].append({"path": NAME, "stored": {"bytes": len(result_bytes), "sha256": digest(result_bytes)}, "encoding": "identity"})
index_path.write_text(json.dumps(index, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
readme_path = OUT / "README.md"
readme = readme_path.read_text()
header = "\n## Native-test correction equivalence\n"
assert header not in readme
readme += header + """
The separate [runtime/compiler equivalence receipt](runtime-equivalence-dec983b2-to-c2c17f7.json)
compares the executed revision above with corrected native-test revision
**c2c17f7a273c45760fd54b9e5a8fe3cd57b0d51b**. Their only non-documentation change
is the ordinary-dot control in test/archive_ntfs_reader_test.dart, which is
absent from all 606 actual portable compiler inputs.

Every actual compiler input, the primary package map, production manifests, and
Dart/Node executable bytes still match the original qualification. Every tracked
compiler input also has the same Git blob at both revisions. This supports reuse
of the portable results for the unchanged inputs at the corrected test revision.
No application or compiler was rerun for this proof: the portable executions
remain attributed to **dec983b2fcb71dea7f90e1020c5d73e3f926a3f6**. The native
suite's execution at the corrected revision is recorded separately.
"""
readme_path.write_text(readme)
assert receipt_path.read_bytes() == receipt_bytes
assert json.loads((OUT / NAME).read_text())["actual_compiler_inputs"]["count"] == 606
assert digest((OUT / NAME).read_bytes()) == index["native_test_correction_equivalence"]["sha256"]
print(json.dumps({
    "result": "equivalent", "actual_execution_revision": EXECUTED,
    "corrected_test_revision": CORRECTED, "actual_inputs_unchanged": 606,
    "tracked_compiler_inputs_with_equal_git_blobs": len(tracked_inputs),
    "only_non_doc_change": TEST, "receipt": str(OUT / NAME),
    "receipt_bytes": len(result_bytes), "no_application_rerun": True,
}))
